title: Flat promotional discount larger than subtotal produces negative tax and negative invoice total
body:
When a customer applies a $40.00 promo coupon to a $25.00 order with 10% sales tax, `calculate_invoice_total` returns:
- `discounted_subtotal`: `-15.00`
- `tax`: `-1.50`
- `total`: `-16.50`

Expected behavior:
Promotional discounts should clamp `discounted_subtotal` at `0.00` before calculating sales tax, so `discounted_subtotal == 0.00`, `tax == 0.00`, and `total == 0.00`.
